visuals.caption: The tangents at the two ends of a diameter are both perpendicular to it, so they are parallel.
Tangents at A and B meet at X with angle X = 70°; A, B, C, D lie on the circle and angle DCB = 125°.
Tangent segments AB and AC, radii MD, MB and MC with angle DMB = 130°, chord CD parallel to AB, and chord CB.
Tangent segments AB and AC, chord BC meeting MA at X, Y the midpoint of chord BD, and angle XYM = 35°.
A circle inside triangle ABC touches the sides at D, E and F.
Quadrilateral ABCD with an inscribed circle M touching AD at L, AB at X, CB at Y and CD at Z; radius R = MY and dashed lines from M to the vertices.
Tangent segments AC = 12 cm and AB = x cm from A to a circle of radius 5 cm, with DA = y cm along MA.
Two touching circles with tangent segments from A: AD = (y − 2) cm, AC = (2x − 3) cm and AB = 15 cm.
Triangle ABC with a circle inside touching all three sides, with the sides marked 5 cm, 6 cm and 7 cm.
Two separate circles N and M with two internal tangent lines AB and CD crossing at F between them.
A small circle N and a large circle M on the same side of two external tangent lines AB and CD that meet at F.
Two tangents from C touch the circle at A and B; AB is the tangent chord and CA, CB are the tangent segments.
Two circles N and M sitting on a common tangent line touching it at B and A, with the distance between centres marked 41 cm.
Tangent segments AC and AB from A, with the dashed radii MC, MB and the line MA.
Tangent segments AB and AC, radii MB and MC, chord BC meeting the line MA at D.
Line MA cuts the chord BC at D at a right angle, and D is the midpoint of BC.
Line MA bisects angle CMB at the centre and angle CAB at A.
Tangent segments AC and AB with angle A = 50°, radii MC and MB, chord CB, and angles y, z and x marked with letters.
Tangent segments AC and AB with MA drawn; angle CAM = 35°, and angles y, z at M and x at A are marked with letters.
Tangent segments AC and AB marked equal, with the chord CB, radii MC and MB, point D on the circle, and angles x, y and z marked with letters.
